name: Environmental Performance Index
publisher: Yale Center for Environmental Law & Policy / Columbia CIESIN

govt_response.title: MoEF&CC rejects EPI 2022 ranking
govt_response.summary: Environment ministry said several indicators rest on 'surmises and unscientific methods' (Indian Express explainer, June 2022); also reported in Hindustan Times: https://www.hindustantimes.com/opinion/indias-lagging-sustainability-performance-101656338200590.html

methodology_note: EPI is biennial and the indicator set changes substantially between editions (e.g. new climate-change indicators in 2022), so ranks across editions are not strictly comparable. Out-of count for 2014 not confirmed (omitted). 2016 edition (reported by some as 141st) and 2012/2010 not confirmed and omitted. Scores: 2018 30.57, 2020 27.6, 2024 27.6 (Wikipedia), 2026 22.46 (Estonia top at 74.79; Laos last at 21.78) per press coverage. 2014 and 2024 points cite an analysis noting a fall from 155th (2014) to 176th (2024). The 2022 rank (180 of 180) was the lowest of any country that edition.
